publicationEvidence: Deploy Prod run 44291949608 (2026-11-18, main f9aa63c79, dispatched without a stack input) succeeded for prod-aws-apne2-v3, prod-aws-apne1-v3, and prod-aws-eun1-v3 (app-instance pulumi-up) and then published the EKS Gateway for every prod cluster. After the run, the Gateway pods of lambdadb-eks-prod-aws-apne2, lambdadb-eks-prod-aws-apne1, and lambdadb-eks-prod-aws-eun1 were read as Running and Ready on gateway image 1487eb2c8adebfec13064e9103022d77ef9096d8, the last commit outside deploy/ that f9aa63c79 contains. It publishes the contract changes since 286546ec: branch-scoped index schemas with the individual branch, tag, and alias routes (lambdadb/lambdadb#587), paginated branch, tag, and alias listings and the rejection of an empty pageToken (lambdadb/lambdadb#605), branches created from tags (lambdadb/lambdadb#606), and the branch, tag, and listing semantics of the OSWALD WAL integration (lambdadb/lambdadb#553). No request was sent to the production API to exercise the new routes.
